parts.name: Outside Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the outside frame of a door set, typically made of wood. It provides structural support and defines the boundary for the door installation.
parts.Functional_description: The frame holds the door in place, allowing it to swing open or closed while maintaining alignment and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame itself is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main door panel of the door set, made of wood and designed to fit within the frame.
parts.Functional_description: The door serves as a movable barrier that can open or close to allow or restrict access through the doorway.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to swing open or closed.
